title: BUGFIX — cmd-session.ts mid-session gate count includes dry-run posts
rationale: In cmd-session.ts around line 174, after recording a post during a posting session, postCount uses readLines(manualPostsPath).length — includes dry-run entries. This inflates the gate display mid-session. Line 202 already uses readRealPosts (correct). Fix line 174 to match.

tasks.description: In scripts/telegram-commands/cmd-session.ts ~line 174: replace readLines(manualPostsPath) with readRealPosts() for postCount. Import is already present.
